description: The Jekyll site itself: includes, layouts, and page conversions that reproduce the existing notebook markup/classes identically, plus the _papers collection (seed paper + auto-listing index) and the additive .paper-body CSS. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the copied source and _config.yml collection/defaults). Produces a complete, buildable site; FEAT-003 adds the publish infrastructure on top and does not depend on this feature's rendering.
steps: Create $WT/_includes/pencil-filter.html = the exact SVG feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap block from the source pages (baseFrequency 0.08, numOctaves 4, seed 7, scale 3). Create $WT/_includes/hole.html = . Create $WT/_includes/header.html per §6.3 = 3 .line-row.blank + a .line-row wrapping {{ include.name }}.

Create $WT/_layouts/notebook.html per §6.4: full doctype/head with the single <title> conditional ({% if page.title_tag %}...{% elsif page.collection == "papers" %}{{ page.title }} — Benjamin Manoj{% else %}{{ page.title }}{% endif %}), <link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css">, body including pencil-filter.html, article.notebook-page, hole.html, div.writing.pencil wrapping {{ content }}.

Convert $WT/index.html per §6.5: front matter layout: notebook, title_tag: "Benjamin Manoj"; body = {% include header.html name="Benjamin Manoj" %}, the .toc-title 'Table of Contents' row, one blank, a nav with three .toc-item entries (Papers->/papers/, Writing->/writing/, About->/about/) each with .toc-label/.toc-leader/.toc-page and literal page numbers 1/2/3, then exactly 15 trailing .line-row.blank rows. HTML comments may be dropped.
Create $WT/_layouts/page.html per §6.6: front matter layout: notebook; body = {% include header.html name=page.heading %}, blank, a .line-row.toc-item with ← Contents, blank, {{ content }}.

Convert $WT/writing/index.html and $WT/about/index.html per §6.6: front matter (layout: page, their title_tag, heading 'Writing'/'About') + the exact .body-line rows verbatim from the current source files (Writing: three pieces + blank + three run-on lines; About: two lines + blank + three run-on lines).

Convert $WT/papers/index.html per §6.7: front matter (layout: page, title_tag 'Papers — Benjamin Manoj', heading 'Papers'); body = {% assign sorted = site.papers | sort: "date" | reverse %} then a {% for paper in sorted %} loop emitting one .line-row.toc-item with <a href="{{ paper.url }}"> containing .toc-label={{ paper.title }}, .toc-leader, .toc-page={{ paper.date | date: "%Y" }}; plus a 'No papers yet.' .body-line empty state when sorted.size == 0.

Create $WT/_layouts/paper.html per §6.8: front matter layout: notebook; body = {% include header.html name=page.title %}, blank, a .toc-item with ← Contents, blank,
{{ content }}
.

Create the seed paper $WT/_papers/2024-01-01-example-paper.md per §8: front matter title (quoted string) + date: 2024-01-01 (UNQUOTED — the required date is the sole sort/%Y guarantee for a custom collection; the filename prefix is convention only), then a body with one paragraph, an h2, and a two-item list.

Append the additive .paper-body CSS block to $WT/style.css per §7.3 (do NOT change any existing selector): .paper-body { font-size: var(--fs-item); line-height: var(--line); transform: translateY(calc(var(--baseline-drop) + (var(--line) - 1em) / 2)); } plus the whole-rule block-margin rules, heading sizes, list indent, code/pre, and underlined .paper-body a.
acceptance_criteria: The generated _site/index.html body contains the SVG pencil filter, article.notebook-page, img.hole[src=/images/bowl.png], div.writing.pencil, 3 .line-row.blank + .header-name 'Benjamin Manoj', .toc-title 'Table of Contents', a nav with three .toc-item (Papers/Writing/About with .toc-label/.toc-leader/.toc-page), and 15 trailing .line-row.blank.
Generated Writing and About pages contain the header, a .toc-item ← Contents back-link to /, and the exact body-line rows from the source files.
Generated /papers/ lists the seed paper as a .toc-item row (title -> paper URL, year in .toc-page) with no manual edit; adding another _papers file and rebuilding lists it too, newest first.
Generated /papers/2024-01-01-example-paper/ shows the title in .header-name, a ← Contents link to /papers/, and the markdown inside .paper-body.
style.css retains every pre-existing selector unchanged; the only addition is the appended .paper-body block (git diff shows only appended lines).
verification: Build the site (see context.json verification_instructions: use a usable Ruby/Jekyll if obtainable; if only Ruby 2.6, use a Jekyll-3.x-compatible gem set in a throwaway vendor/ as a markup proxy and note CI owns the real 4.3 build; if no usable Ruby at all, assert markup shape statically and say the build could not run locally — do NOT fabricate).

With `jekyll serve` running: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' for http://localhost:4000/ , /papers/ , /papers/2024-01-01-example-paper/ , /writing/ , /about/ each returns 200; curl /style.css /fonts/Crayonia.ttf /images/bowl.png return 200.
curl -s http://localhost:4000/papers/ | grep -q 'example-paper' (seed paper auto-listed); curl the home page and grep for header-name 'Benjamin Manoj' and 15 'line-row blank' trailing rows.

git -C /Users/benjaminmanoj/Documents/benmanoj/.worktrees/publish-workflow diff style.css shows only appended .paper-body lines. Clean up _site/, .jekyll-cache/, vendor/, and any throwaway Gemfile.lock afterward.
findings:
Implemented all FEAT-002 deliverables: 3 includes (_includes/pencil-filter.html, hole.html, header.html), 3 layouts (_layouts/notebook.html with the single title conditional, page.html, paper.html), converted index.html (layout: notebook, title_tag, header include, TOC title row + blank, nav with 3 .toc-item entries Papers/Writing/About pages 1/2/3, then 15 trailing .line-row.blank), converted writing/index.html and about/index.html (layout: page, title_tag, heading, exact .body-line rows verbatim), converted papers/index.html (layout: page, auto-list loop over site.papers sorted by date reverse with 'No papers yet.' empty state), seeded _papers/2024-01-01-example-paper.md (title quoted, date 2024-01-01 unquoted, paragraph + h2 + 2-item list), and appended the additive .paper-body CSS block to style.css (git diff confirmed 54 insertions, 0 deletions — no existing selector touched).

Build verification (markup proxy, per context.json): local Ruby is 2.6.10 with NO C toolchain (Xcode CLT absent), so Jekyll 4.3 cannot run and native gems (ffi, eventmachine, http_parser.rb) cannot compile. Used a Jekyll-3.9.5 pure-Ruby gem set in a throwaway vendor/proxy-gems as a MARKUP PROXY (serve-only native gems stubbed since 'jekyll build' never uses them; vendor excluded from the build). Build succeeded (BUILD_OK) producing _site/{index,about/index,writing/index,papers/index,papers/2024-01-01-example-paper/index}.html + style.css/fonts/images. CI/Ruby 3.3 owns the real production Jekyll 4.3 build. Served _site via pure-Ruby WEBrick and curled all routes: / /papers/ /papers/2024-01-01-example-paper/ /writing/ /about/ and /style.css /fonts/Crayonia.ttf /images/bowl.png ALL returned HTTP 200. Home page markup verified: feTurbulence filter, article.notebook-page, img.hole[src=/images/bowl.png], div.writing.pencil, header-name 'Benjamin Manoj', 'Table of Contents', 3 nav .toc-item, and 19 total .line-row.blank (3 header + 1 post-TOC + 15 trailing). Papers index auto-lists the seed paper (title 'An Example Paper' -> /papers/2024-01-01-example-paper/, year 2024 in .toc-page) with no manual edit; adding a temporary 2025 paper and rebuilding listed it newest-first then removed it. Paper page shows title in .header-name, back-link to /papers/, markdown in .paper-body (h2 + 2 <li>), and <title>An Example Paper — Benjamin Manoj</title> (proving the page.collection=='papers' conditional). Writing/About body lines confirmed verbatim. Root-relative /style.css resolves. Cleaned up _site/, .jekyll-cache/, vendor/, .bundle/ and the throwaway Gemfile.lock before committing (none remain).
